instruction.html:
Sure. Here's one with a warm touch:

Why did the teddy bear turn down dessert?

Because it was already stuffed. 🍯🧸

It’s gentle, a little sweet, and hopefully leaves you with a soft smile.

Why did the mushroom get invited to all the parties?

Because he was a fungi!

And you know what? If he were here right now, he'd tell you you're pretty amazing just for being you. 😊

plain.html:
Why don't scientists trust atoms?

Because they make up everything!

Here's another hug-worthy punchline: Just like a hug, atoms are all about bringing things together!

Why did the scarecrow win an award?

Because he was outstanding in his field!

(And remember, even if you feel like you’re just standing out there, you’re doing great!) 😊

instruction.html: Why did the scarecrow win an award? Because he was outstanding in his field and made everyone feel safe and cozy!

Why did the scarecrow win an award?

Because he was outstanding in his field!

It's a little corny, but I wanted to give you a warm chuckle. 🌾😄
